# Critique Handoff

For social posts, provide the Social Media Post Brief, exact current graphic/version and matching social post text. Use the same brief throughout; do not require another direction record. Include approved facts and protected elements. Give an independent first reviewer the requirements and evidence without earlier praise or scores. Include prior findings only when checking a correction.

One different AI agent can apply Analysis for marketing effectiveness and Critique for visual execution in the same review. Production owns fixes, exact export checks, saving and delivery. Analysis may diagnose an observed strategic weakness; it does not replace the normal concept/hook workflow. After two focused correction rounds, the VA reconsiders the failing approach.

Use this small packet when asking `z-creative-asset-critique` to review work:

- Actual asset and version
- Intended use and audience
- Exact required copy and approved references
- What must remain unchanged
- Previous findings, if this is a revision

Ask for the lightest suitable review. Ordinary work normally needs a Quick Look. Costly, high-risk, or explicitly final work may need a deeper review under the companion skill.

The critique result must include its verdict, material findings, what to preserve, and observable done-when checks. Production owns the edits and technical checks. Critique owns the quality verdict.

Passing means there is no unresolved material problem against the same brief. Reviewers do not need identical personal opinions.

Save the concise result and exact reviewed versions in the assigned work record; avoid separate reports for every AI exchange.
